name: Madogoshi no Heya 2
source:
The window of the next house is seen from protagonist's room. Girls live there, but they shut the curtains at every attempt of dialogue. One day main character receives a message from that room "Don't you want to come to my place?"

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-august-2003-natsuyume-yawa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
从主人公房间能看见隔壁房子的窗户。那里住着女孩，但每次尝试交谈，她们都会拉上窗帘。一天，主人公收到那间房传来的讯息：「你不想来我这里吗？」

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-august-2003-natsuyume-yawa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
